title: Define aom install/stage/activate invariant
purpose: Freeze the ecosystem invariant that install and stage are inert, while activation is a controlled runtime side effect.
scope: Define search, fetch, verify, stage, diff, activate, deactivate and rollback lifecycle.
State that staged artifacts cannot change runtime behavior.
Require activation to produce AgentCore PlanSpec.
Require activation side effects to go through SecurityExecutionEngine.
acceptance_criteria: Activation path includes AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
Traditional package manager mutation is treated as an adapter workflow, not aom baseline.
Community/local-dev artifacts are not production-promotable by default.
verification: Docs mention install/stage != activate and AgentCore PlanSpec.
failure_modes: aom owns host package mutation directly.
